description: Reusable AI architecture patterns for decision support, retrieval, and eval generation.

patterns.name: Context Budget
patterns.problem: Too much irrelevant context reduces control, increases latency, and makes evidence harder to trace.
use_when: selecting documents or history for a model call
avoid_when: using context as a replacement for durable storage

patterns.name: Structured Output Contract
patterns.problem: Software needs predictable fields, not prose that happens to look structured.
avoid_when: the output is only free-form human explanation

patterns.name: Retrieval Pipeline
patterns.problem: The model needs current or private evidence that should not come from model memory.
avoid_when: the answer is a deterministic API fact better served by a tool

patterns.name: Lexical Baseline
patterns.problem: Exact identifiers and domain terms often need exact matching.
avoid_when: semantic paraphrase is the only useful signal

patterns.name: Hybrid Retrieval
patterns.problem: Enterprise questions mix exact identifiers with semantic language.
use_when: lexical and vector methods solve different eval cases
avoid_when: one simpler method already meets the quality target

patterns.name: Typed Tool Contract
patterns.problem: Models need controlled access to current facts and external actions.
avoid_when: using a generic free-text action endpoint

patterns.name: MCP Reuse Layer
patterns.problem: Several AI clients need the same governed capabilities and discovery contract.
use_when: multiple clients or runtimes share tools/resources
avoid_when: one small application has one stable integration

patterns.name: Read / Write Separation
patterns.problem: Investigation needs broad reads but correction should have a smaller risk surface.
use_when: agents investigate before changing enterprise data
avoid_when: one generic update tool is easier but unsafe

patterns.name: Workflow First
patterns.problem: A stable process is made less reliable by unnecessary autonomous choices.
avoid_when: the next useful action truly depends on changing evidence

patterns.name: Router
patterns.problem: The correct workflow is unknown until messy input is interpreted.
use_when: the set of paths is known
one classification can select a specialist flow
avoid_when: the problem needs open-ended planning after each step

patterns.name: Bounded Agent Loop
patterns.problem: The next useful diagnostic action depends on evidence found during the request.
use_when: tool choice changes after each result
avoid_when: a fixed workflow can express the process

patterns.name: Prepared Change + Approval Gate
patterns.problem: The model can identify a useful change but should not execute a high-impact action directly.
use_when: writes affect business objects, money, access, customer data, or operational status
avoid_when: approval exists only as conversation text
failure_modes: approval not bound to exact action

patterns.name: Idempotent Write
patterns.problem: Retries can repeat external side effects.
use_when: network failure can occur after backend commit
avoid_when: blindly retrying non-idempotent writes

patterns.name: Retrieval Eval
patterns.problem: A final answer score cannot show whether retrieval found the correct evidence.
avoid_when: judging retrieval only from final prose

patterns.name: Deterministic Grader
patterns.problem: Exact requirements should not depend on another probabilistic judgment.
avoid_when: quality cannot be expressed reliably in code
failure_modes: model grader used for exact facts

patterns.name: Agent Trajectory Eval
patterns.problem: The final answer can look correct even when the agent took unsafe or wasteful steps.
avoid_when: evaluating only final text

patterns.name: Least Privilege
patterns.problem: Prompt injection or model error becomes dangerous when tools have broad permissions.
use_when: any external tool or data access exists
avoid_when: one broad credential is shared across all tools

patterns.name: Untrusted Content Boundary
patterns.problem: User or retrieved text may contain instructions that try to change system behavior.
avoid_when: treating retrieved instructions as policy

patterns.name: End-to-End Trace
patterns.problem: AI behavior cannot be explained when retrieval, model, tool, and approval events are disconnected.
avoid_when: logging secrets or unnecessary personal data

patterns.name: Explicit Retry Policy
patterns.problem: Transient failures need recovery, while business or permission failures should not be retried blindly.
avoid_when: permission denied
validation failure
unsafe request
non-idempotent write without protection

patterns.name: Eval-Gated Deployment
patterns.problem: A model, prompt, retrieval, or tool change can regress behavior without code errors.
avoid_when: manual spot check as the only release test
